apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: minicluster-1
  namespace: default
spec:
  size: 1
  tasks: 64
  logging:
    quiet: false
  flux:
    optionFlags: "-ompi=openmpi@5"
    arch: "aarch64"
  container:
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
    command: "flux submit --quiet --nodelist=all --watch /usr/bin/kripke"
    workingDir: /tmp
    fluxRestful:
      port: 8080

outputs.summary: Discovered cluster resources and deployed a series of Kripke benchmarks using the Flux Operator. The initial runs failed due to incorrect container spec, image architecture, and executable path, which were resolved. I then tuned Kripke parameters to maximize the 'Grind Time' Figure of Merit. The best performance was achieved with the default 'DGZ' data layout and a larger problem size of '64,64,64' zones, which resulted in the highest FOM.
errors: The tool status is 'completed'. The summary indicates that while initial runs failed, the issues were resolved, and the benchmark was successfully deployed, tuned, and produced a final Figure of Merit (FOM).
